research_rationale:
EO 12095 (Creating an emergency board to investigate a dispute between Wien Air Alaska, Inc. and certain individuals), signed 1978-11-02. The order creates an emergency board for a dispute between Wien Air Alaska, Inc. and certain individuals, under Section 44 of the Airline Deregulation Act of 1978; Section 1-101 establishes a board of three members and Section 1-102 requires its report within 30 days of the date of the order. The held text has no maintaining-conditions section. First end: Section 5 of EO 12379 (signed 1982-08-17, Termination of Boards, Committees, and Commissions) names this order by number, "Executive Order No. 12095," and provides that it is revoked. EO 12379 has no effective-date clause, so the revocation took effect on signing, 1982-08-17.
